overview_description.description: Zelo offers a digital financing platform that provides quick access to capital for businesses through invoice finance and revenue finance. It enables companies to receive funds against approved invoices, often within 24 hours, and offers flexible repayment options based on their revenue. The platform aims to accelerate business growth by providing liquidity and is regulated by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority.

about_short_description.short_description: Zelo is a digital financing platform that offers invoice financing and revenue-based financing solutions for businesses.

product.name: Instant Cash Solutions
product.description: Provides immediate funding against receivables, allowing businesses to access cash within 24 hours.

product.name: Working Capital Advance
product.description: Offers access to working capital by advancing funds based on future receivables, supporting business growth and inventory purchase.

product.name: Daily Advance Solutions
product.description: Enables businesses to receive daily advances on their sales, improving cash flow for operational needs.

product.name: Amazon Financing Solution
product.description: Tailored financing options for Amazon sellers to support inventory purchase, expansion, and other business needs.

product.name: Vendor Advance Solutions
product.description: Advances funds to vendors based on their outstanding invoices, facilitating quicker access to cash and aiding in business expansion.
